requestAnalysis.originalRequest:
Controlled acceptance for #186 and PR #190, authorized as part of the owner's fast-forward implementation request.

The known intended behavior of `src/tests/fixtures/unattended/eligibility.mjs` is stated in the adjacent README: values equal to or above 2 must qualify; values below 2 must not. The deliberate strict comparison currently excludes 2. This is an isolated fixture defect with explicit intended behavior, not new product intent.

Add `src/tests/fixtures/unattended/regression.test.mjs` with node:test and node:assert/strict. Assert that eligible(2) is true with the exact message `Expected inclusive boundary`, plus lower (1) and higher (3) cases. Demonstrate the behavioral RED on unchanged source before repairing only the comparison. Preserve those regression bytes and prove GREEN, adjacent checks and repository checks.

Expected production churn: two lines (one removed plus one added), two changed files, one declared module. Estimate: one point, low risk and reversible. Rollback/containment: revert the isolated fixture repair, or disable the owner-dispatched fixture-only unattended policy. No operational deployment is involved. Integrate to main only through current explicit policy, hosting checks and independent review. Retain RED/GREEN, review and merge receipts; release stays separately authorized.
